title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The correct final expression for the partial derivative of heat emitted with respect to pressure at constant temperature must be provided.

title: Maxwell's Relation
description: Important Criteria: The application of Maxwell's relation to relate entropy and volume must be correctly stated.

title: Correct Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The derivation leading from Maxwell's relation to the final answer must be logically sound and clearly presented.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units for heat emitted, pressure, and temperature should be consistent and correctly applied throughout the solution.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes in applying the Maxwell's relation or in the final expression will result in a deduction.
